'''2007 New Jersey State Championship Greg Hitt LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Hitt]] at [[2007 New Jersey State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' QMC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
